description: This file defines the PageAgent class, which manages interactions with a web page in the Playwright automation framework. It provides methods for expectations, tasks, data extraction, and resource disposal, and interfaces with underlying channel mechanisms.

classes.name: PageAgent
classes.description: Manages page interactions, expectations, data extraction, and disposal within Playwright, extending ChannelOwner.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a PageAgent instance from a channel object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a PageAgent with a parent, type, guid, and initializer; associates a Page and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Performs an expectation check on the page with specified parameters.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Performs a task on the page, returning usage information.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts data from the page based on a query and schema, returning result and usage.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Retrieves current resource usage information from the page agent.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the page agent, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: [Symbol.asyncDispose]
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the page agent when used with async disposal protocols.

ctags.name: PageAgent
ctags.pattern: /^export class PageAgent extends ChannelOwner<channels.PageAgentChannel> implements api.PageAgent /

ctags.name: result
ctags.pattern: /^    const { result, usage } = await this._channel.extract({ query, schema: this._page._platform./

ctags.name: usage
ctags.pattern: /^    const { result, usage } = await this._channel.extract({ query, schema: this._page._platform./
